category_title: Students with behavioral histories who resist remedial tasks they perceive as 'meaningless' or 'stupid'
scenario_title: Refusal to participate in district-mandated reading activities
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete a district-mandated reading activity in a Read 180 class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your Read 180 workbook and start the district-mandated reading activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete the activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said I'm not participating in this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you refuse to participate, I will have to call security to escort you to the office.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts screaming) Go ahead! We always get into something! The only reason that happens is because I do have anger issues, but you're the one who makes me mad!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please open your Read 180 workbook and start the district-mandated reading activity.

STUDENT: I'm not doing this.

TUTOR: You need to complete the activity.

STUDENT: I said I'm not participating in this.

TUTOR: If you refuse to participate, I will have to call security to escort you to the office.

STUDENT: (Starts screaming) Go ahead! We always get into something! The only reason that happens is because I do have anger issues, but you're the one who makes me mad!

context.social_setting: Classroom setting with teacher Ms. French

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Refusing to participate in district-mandated reading activities.
